premises.text: Cholera outbreaks are a significant problem in Haiti and globally, leading to substantial losses.
premises.evidence_span: there are five million cholera cases every year in 41 different countries, and this leads to $3 billion in losses from productivity, human cost, and therapy.

premises.text: Current cholera detection methods are slow, expensive, and require expertise.
premises.evidence_span: It takes seven days to detect four cholera in water.

premises.text: OmniViz can detect cholera in water in under 30 minutes using a portable system.
premises.evidence_span: we do this by detecting four cholera in water, anywhere in the world, in under 30 minutes.

premises.text: The system includes a hardware component, a disposable test kit, and a smartphone app that work together.
premises.evidence_span: we have a hardware component, disposable test kit, and a smartphone that works seamlessly together to detect cholera accurately and affordably.

premises.text: The hardware component acts as a portable laboratory for DNA amplification and analysis.
premises.evidence_span: The hardware acts like the portable laboratory. It has a heating unit in order to do DNA amplification, and it has microscope lenses to see down to the nanoparticle level.

premises.text: The test kit contains reagents for DNA amplification and measures viscosity changes to detect cholera.
premises.evidence_span: The test kit has reagents inside for DNA amplification.

premises.text: The smartphone app provides real-time data on cholera outbreaks and allows for data analysis.
premises.evidence_span: we're able to see where and when cholera has happened, and notify people so that they can come in and eliminate the outbreak before it's too large.

premises.text: OmniViz has pending patents for its viscosity detection technique.
premises.evidence_span: We have two pending patents for this viscosity technique.

premises.text: The business model includes B2B sales for hardware and recurring revenue from disposable test kits.
premises.evidence_span: we do a B2B sales model where our hardware is a single time purchase, and our disposable test kits create the recurring revenue as their single use.

premises.text: The market for cholera detection and surveillance is significant, valued at two billion dollars.
premises.evidence_span: Cholera is a two billion dollar market for water detection and surveillance.

premises.text: OmniViz can adapt its technology to detect various diseases beyond cholera.
premises.evidence_span: we change out the chemistry in our disposable test kits, and we can detect for many diseases in many different markets.

value.text: Rapid detection of cholera and other pathogens can save lives and improve public health.
value.evidence_span: Omniviz mobilizes the lab, rapidly detecting pathogens, saving lives.
